intro.paragraph_1: Hi! I'm Thomas, a full-stack developer originally from Nantes, France, now based in Gran Canaria. Before settling down to code by the ocean, I spent years backpacking around the world—New Zealand, Australia, Asia, the USA, and beyond. That nomadic lifestyle taught me to adapt quickly and embrace new challenges, which is exactly how I approach development.
intro.paragraph_2: I build modern web applications from end to end. Whether it's crafting smooth user interfaces, setting up servers, or handling databases, I enjoy working across the entire stack. Most of my time goes into frontend work, creating interactive experiences that feel polished and responsive.
intro.paragraph_3: Fluent in French, English, and Spanish, I work with international teams and clients worldwide.
